title: Boundary Record
governance_note: Energy balance conclusions are not meaningful without a defined boundary.

title: Flow Record
governance_note: Omitted flows can change the interpretation of imbalance.

title: Storage Record
governance_note: Equilibrium should not be confused with immediate response.

title: Forcing Record
governance_note: Forcing assumptions should be documented as historical, scenario-based, or experimental.

title: Feedback Record
governance_note: Feedback terms can hide multiple physical processes.

title: Calibration Record
governance_note: A model can fit temperature while misrepresenting mechanism.

title: Claim Boundary
governance_note: Energy balance conclusions should not exceed boundary definitions, data evidence, uncertainty, domain review, and tested scope.
